animals.title: The Mantis Shrimp
animals.subtitle: It punches fast enough to boil the sea
animals.script: Mantis shrimp. Fifty miles an hour, underwater. Fast enough to boil the water it swims in. Every punch fires a bubble that collapses in a flash of light, hotter than the surface of the sun. Animal one: impossible superpowers.

stat.label: strike speed underwater
stat.caption: The fastest punch in the ocean

animals.imagePrompt: macro underwater still of a peacock mantis shrimp, iridescent teal and magenta, dark volcanic sand, single light shaft, prestige documentary

animals.title: The Axolotl
animals.subtitle: It grows back pieces of its own brain
animals.script: Axolotl. Lose a limb and it grows back whole. Muscle, bone, nerves, even part of the spinal cord. Regeneration runs on cells that never finish growing up. It stays a child its entire life. Animal two.
animals.imagePrompt: cinematic still of a pink axolotl in dark water, feathery gills backlit, black-green aquatic plants, shallow depth of field

animals.title: The Tardigrade
animals.subtitle: It survives the vacuum of space
animals.script: Tardigrade. Half a millimetre long, and it survives space. Vacuum, radiation, boiling water, decades of drought. It drains itself into a glass-like state and stops. When water returns, it walks again. Animal three.

stat.label: pressure survived
stat.caption: The animal that cannot be killed

animals.imagePrompt: extreme macro of a tardigrade, translucent segmented body and claws, crystalline ice field, cool blue rim light, documentary microscopy aesthetic

animals.title: The Electric Eel
animals.subtitle: It hunts with eight hundred volts
animals.script: Electric eel. Eight hundred and sixty volts, fired into the water. Three organs stack cells like batteries. It can remote control the muscles of a hiding fish, forcing it to twitch and give itself away. Animal four.

stat.label: peak discharge
stat.caption: A lightning storm with a spine

animals.imagePrompt: cinematic underwater still of a large electric eel in murky dark river water, bioelectric shimmer along its flank, single torch beam

animals.title: The Immortal Jellyfish
animals.subtitle: It ages backwards to escape death
animals.script: Immortal jellyfish. Wounded or starving, it reverses its own life. The adult body melts back into a juvenile polyp and starts again. It can loop forever. The only animal that never has to grow old. Animal five.

stat.label: known natural lifespan
stat.caption: The creature that refuses to end
